Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using the BS3 linker to map the interaction between NOSIP and TNPO1. While the PRIDE metadata lists 'Chemical cross-linking' as the experiment type, this maps to a complexome-style modifier (mod_complexome) for routing purposes. Acquisition is clearly DDA based on the 'top 25' precursor selection.

cell_lines: In living HeLa cells, transportin 1 seems to be the major nuclear import receptor for NOSIP.
scope: His-NOSIP, 20 µM, and 20 µM His-TNPO1 were incubated for 2 h on ice in a total volume of 300 µl, and complexes were purified using a Superdex S200 analytical 10/300 GL column
Complex-containing fractions were pooled and cross-linked using bis(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate (BS3...)
shifted bands in the gel corresponding to TNPO1 cross-linked to NOSIP were cut out and analyzed
